54:   /*
55:    * The path members. It corresponds directly to stack: At indices where the
56:    * stack contains an object (EMPTY_OBJECT, DANGLING_NAME or NONEMPTY_OBJECT),
57:    * pathNames contains the name at this scope. Where it contains an array
58:    * (EMPTY_ARRAY, NONEMPTY_ARRAY) pathIndices contains the current index in
59:    * that array. Otherwise the value is undefined, and we take advantage of that
60:    * by incrementing pathIndices when doing so isn't useful.
61:    */

63:   public int[] pathIndices = new int[32];

67:     push(element);

70:   @Override public void beginArray() throws IOException {
71:     expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY);
72:     JsonArray array = (JsonArray) peekStack();
73:     push(array.iterator());
74:     pathIndices[stackSize - 1] = 0;
75:   }

77:   @Override public void endArray() throws IOException {
78:     expect(JsonToken.END_ARRAY);
79:     popStack(); // empty iterator
80:     popStack(); // array
81:     if (stackSize > 0) {

83:     }
84:   }

87:     expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT);
88:     JsonObject object = (JsonObject) peekStack();
89:     push(object.entrySet().iterator());

93:     expect(JsonToken.END_OBJECT);
94:     popStack(); // empty iterator

98:     }

102:     JsonToken token = peek();
103:     return token != JsonToken.END_OBJECT && token != JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
104:   }

106:   @Override public JsonToken peek() throws IOException {
107:     if (stackSize == 0) {

112:     if (o instanceof Iterator) {

115:       if (iterator.hasNext()) {

238:     JsonToken token = peek();
239:     if (token != JsonToken.NUMBER && token != JsonToken.STRING) {
240:       throw new IllegalStateException(

242:     }

244:     popStack();
245:     if (stackSize > 0) {

247:     }

252:     stack = new Object[] { SENTINEL_CLOSED };

254:   }

265:     expect(JsonToken.NAME);
266:     Iterator<?> i = (Iterator<?>) peekStack();
267:     Map.Entry<?, ?> entry = (Map.Entry<?, ?>) i.next();
268:     push(entry.getValue());

272:   private void push(Object newTop) {
273:     if (stackSize == stack.length) {
274:       Object[] newStack = new Object[stackSize * 2];
275:       int[] newPathIndices = new int[stackSize * 2];
276:       String[] newPathNames = new String[stackSize * 2];
277:       System.arraycopy(stack, 0, newStack, 0, stackSize);
278:       System.arraycopy(pathIndices, 0, newPathIndices, 0, stackSize);
279:       System.arraycopy(pathNames, 0, newPathNames, 0, stackSize);
280:       stack = newStack;
281:       pathIndices = newPathIndices;
282:       pathNames = newPathNames;
283:     }
284:     stack[stackSize++] = newTop;
285:   }

288:     StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder().append('$');
289:     for (int i = 0; i < stackSize; i++) {
290:       if (stack[i] instanceof JsonArray) {
291:         if (stack[++i] instanceof Iterator) {
292:           result.append('[').append(pathIndices[i]).append(']');
293:         }
294:       } else if (stack[i] instanceof JsonObject) {
295:         if (stack[++i] instanceof Iterator) {
296:           result.append('.');
297:           if (pathNames[i] != null) {
298:             result.append(pathNames[i]);
299:           }
300:         }
301:       }
302:     }
303:     return result.toString();

All 11 failures (7 failures + 4 errors) are identical on the unmodified baseline — they're pre-existing date/locale environment issues unrelated to this fix. Everything else passes, including the previously failing `JsonTreeReaderTest.testSkipValue_emptyJsonObject` and `testSkipValue_filledJsonObject`.

Summary of the fix:
- **gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonTreeReader.java:256** — restored the proper `skipValue()` implementation with `stackSize > 0` guards so popping the last stack entry no longer causes `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: -1` (the broken delegation to `JsonObject.skipValue(this)` is removed), and reverted the fields to `private`.
- **gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/JsonObject.java** — removed the injected broken static `skipValue(JsonTreeReader)` helper and its extra imports.
- **gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/LinkedTreeMap.java** — reverted the visibility changes to `root`, `size`, `header`, and `Node` that only existed to support that helper.
